STEP 3. Check the sensor output voltage at ECM 
connector C-62 <M/T> or PCM connector C-59 <A/T> by 
backprobing.
(1) Do not disconnect the connector C-62 <M/T> or C-59 <A/
T>.
(2) Start the engine and run at idle.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 73 and ground by 
backprobing.
• Warming up the engine. When the engine is 2,500 r/min, 
the output voltage should repeat 0 volt and 0.6 to 1.0 
volt alternately.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to the "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Go to Step 6.
STEP 4. Check connector B-23 at left bank heated oxygen 
sensor (rear) and connector C-62 at ECM <M/T> or 
connector C-59 at PCM <A/T> for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 15.
